# Project parameters 
project_name <- params$project_name

# Inputs and thresholds
input_qc_approved <- strsplit(params$input_qc_approved, split = ';')[[1]]
input_exp_table <- params$input_exp_table

# Optional parameters

# Dataflow/Computational parameters

n_memory <- params$n_memory

## Loading library

```{r library}
#| output: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library(BPCells)

```

## Folder structure

```{r project_directory}
#| output: false

if(!dir.exists(work_directory)) {
  dir.create(work_directory, recursive = T)
}

for(sub_directory in c('data', 'figures')) {
  dir.create(paste0(work_directory, '/', sub_directory))
}

```

## Loading metadata

```{r}
#| warning: false

metadata <- readr::read_csv(file = input_exp_table)
metadata <- metadata %>%
  # Drop non-metadata columns if present. any_of() tolerates their absence,
  # so the same samplesheet can carry matrix paths (h5, metrics_csv) and still
  # be reused here as the metadata table without erroring on missing columns.
  select(-any_of(c("sampleIndex", "fastq_1", "fastq_2", "h5", "metrics_csv"))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  as.data.frame()

```

## Merging Seurat objects

```{r merge, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

# Adjusting names
sample_label <- sub(
  '(\\S+)_seurat_object.RDS', '\\1', basename(input_qc_approved))

sample_label <- setNames(
  input_qc_approved,
  sample_label
)

# On-disk store for the per-sample BPCells matrices. Kept under data/ so it is
# published with the merged object.
bpcells_root <- file.path('data', 'bpcells')
if (dir.exists(bpcells_root)) unlink(bpcells_root, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(bpcells_root, recursive = TRUE)

# Read each QC-approved sample, prefix its barcodes, and persist its counts as
# an on-disk BPCells matrix. BPCells uses 64-bit indexing, so the joined matrix
# is NOT bound by the ~2.1 billion non-zero ceiling of an in-memory dgCMatrix
# (which caused the 'vector::reserve' failure in JoinLayers at cohort scale).
counts_list <- list()
meta_list   <- list()

for (label in names(sample_label)) {

  obj <- readRDS(file = sample_label[[label]])
  obj$raw_cell_id <- Cells(obj)
  obj <- RenameCells(obj, add.cell.id = label)

  counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(obj, assay = 'RNA', layer = 'counts')

  mat_dir <- file.path(bpcells_root, label)
  BPCells::write_matrix_dir(mat = counts, dir = mat_dir, overwrite = TRUE)

  counts_list[[label]] <- BPCells::open_matrix_dir(dir = mat_dir)
  meta_list[[label]]   <- obj@meta.data

  rm(obj, counts); gc()
}

# Align to a common gene set (identical when samples share a reference) and
# column-bind the on-disk matrices into a single 64-bit-backed counts matrix.
gene_sets    <- lapply(counts_list, rownames)
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, gene_sets)

if (!all(vapply(gene_sets, function(g) identical(g, common_genes), logical(1)))) {
  message(sprintf('Aligning samples to %d shared genes', length(common_genes)))
  counts_list <- lapply(counts_list, function(m) m[common_genes, ])
}

combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, counts_list)

# Consolidate the concatenated matrix into ONE on-disk store at a predictable
# relative path (data/bpcells_counts). Downstream steps stage this directory at
# the same relative location so the object's on-disk references resolve. Then
# drop the now-redundant per-sample stores.
counts_store <- file.path('data', 'bpcells_counts')
if (dir.exists(counts_store)) unlink(counts_store, recursive = TRUE)
BPCells::write_matrix_dir(mat = combined_counts, dir = counts_store)
combined_counts <- BPCells::open_matrix_dir(dir = counts_store)
unlink(bpcells_root, recursive = TRUE)

# Combined per-cell metadata (common columns; barcodes already made unique).
# Drop the auto-computed count columns so CreateSeuratObject regenerates them.
common_cols   <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(meta_list, colnames))
combined_meta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(meta_list, function(m) m[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]))
combined_meta <- combined_meta[, setdiff(colnames(combined_meta),
                                         c('nCount_RNA', 'nFeature_RNA')), drop = FALSE]

# One object with a single BPCells-backed counts layer: no in-memory
# JoinLayers/StitchMatrix is required, so the 32-bit ceiling never applies.
seurat_object <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts    = combined_counts,
  project   = project_name,
  meta.data = combined_meta
)

```

## Unifying sample layers

```{r seurat_rejoin}
#| code-fold: true

# The counts were column-bound into a single BPCells-backed layer above, so
# there is normally only one layer here and nothing to join. The guard remains
# so the notebook still behaves correctly if a multi-layer object is ever passed.
if (length(SeuratObject::Layers(seurat_object, assay = 'RNA')) > 1) {

  seurat_object <- JoinLayers(seurat_object)

}

```

## Adding metadata columns

```{r adding_metadata}

# Keeping cell idents
priviosional <- seurat_object@meta.data
priviosional$barcode <- row.names(priviosional)

priviosional <- merge(
  priviosional,
  metadata,
  by.x = "orig.ident",
  by.y = "sample"
)

rownames(priviosional) <- priviosional$barcode
priviosional$barcode <- NULL

# Adding metadata

seurat_object <- AddMetaData(
  object = seurat_object,
  metadata = priviosional
)

```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| column: screen-inset-shaded

# Preview a random subset of cells. Embedding the full metadata (potentially
# millions of rows at cohort scale) into the HTML would exhaust memory / produce
# an unusably large report.
preview_meta <- seurat_object@meta.data
if (nrow(preview_meta) > 2000) {
  preview_meta <- preview_meta[sample(nrow(preview_meta), 2000), , drop = FALSE]
}

DT::datatable(preview_meta,
    caption = sprintf('Random preview of 2,000 of %s total cells', format(ncol(seurat_object), big.mark = ',')),
    class = 'cell-border stripe',
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = 'top',
    width = '100%',
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE))

```

## Saving Seurat object

```{r object_dump}

if(auto_save) {
  
  saveRDS(seurat_object, file = paste0('data/', project_name, '_qc_merged_object.RDS'))
  
}

```
